heading_path.h3: Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids 1. The picture below shows a cube. The length, width and height of the cube are 5 cm. Find the volume of the cube.
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

1. The picture below shows a cube. The length, width and height of the cube are 5 cm. Find the volume of the cube.
record.answer_text:
The volume of any prism is $V = \text{area of base} \times \text{height of prism}$. A cube is a prism with a square as its base.

$$
\begin{array}{ll}
{V}_\text{cube} & {= \text{area of base} \times \text{height of cube}} \\
& {= s \times s \times s}\\
& {= 5 \times 5 \times 5}\\
\text{V}_{cube} & {= \text{125 cm}^{3}} \\
\end{array}
$$

Answer: The volume of the cube is 125 cm$^{3}$.

heading_path.h3: Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

record.evidence_quote: ### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids 2. The picture below shows a cube. The length, width and height of the cube are 30 mm. Find the volume of the cube.
record.prompt_text:
### Exercise 13.13: Find the volume of cubes and cuboids

2. The picture below shows a cube. The length, width and height of the cube are 30 mm. Find the volume of the cube.
record.answer_text:
$$
\begin{array}{ll}
{V}_\text{cube} & {= s \times s \times s}\\
& {= 30 \times 30 \times 30}\\
& {= \text{900} \times \text{30}} \\
\text{V}_{cube} & {= \text{27,000 mm}^{3}} \\
\end{array}
$$

The volume of the cube is 27,000 mm$^{3}$.
